HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 10 02 13 - 7PM
HOUSING AUTHORITY MINUTES - 10 02 13 - 7PM
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
OCTOBER 02, 2013
07:00 P.M.
AGENDA NO. 97
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be webcasted live at www.cityofpalmdale.org and broadcasted live on Spectrum Channel 27.
NOTE: Materials related to an item on this Agenda submitted to the Council or any of its Authorities after distribution of the agenda packet will be available for public inspection at themeeting and after themeeting in the City Clerk's office, located at 38300 Sierra Highway, Ste. C during normal business hours. Those items provided by others at the meeting will be available in the City Clerk's office during normal business hours.
For record keeping purposes and in the event that staff may need to contact you, we request that a speaker's form, located on the table in the foyer, be completed and deposited with the City Clerk. This will then be public information. Please note that you are not required to complete this form or state your name and residence in order to speak. A three-minute time limit will be imposed on all speakers other than staff members.
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk's Office at (661) 267-5151 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments, cheering, foul language, or obscenities.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the City Council to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off or mute your cell phones and mobile devices.
1. CALL TO ORDER.
2. ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
3. WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Staff Recommendation: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting. (Vote - Requires a majority to waive.)
4. CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
5. CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-009, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY (LOCATED AT 507 EAST AVENUE Q3, AND 38627 32ND STREET EAST). (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA5.1
5.2 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-010, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RATIFYING THE ACCEPTANCE OF INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY (LOCATED AT 507 EAST AVENUE Q3, AND 38627 32ND STREET EAST). (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA5.2
5.3 ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-011, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING MODIFICATIONS OF UNDER SECURED MOBILE HOME LOANS AND SHORT SALES OF CERTAIN MOBILE HOMES. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
HA5.3
5.4 Approve the minutes from the previous meeting held September 4, 2013 (7:00 p.m.). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
HA5.4
5.5 Approve the final year-end budget adjustments to the Housing Authority's 2012-13 fiscal year budget. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
Staff Recommendation: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar. (Voice Vote - Requires a majority to approve.)
HA5.5
6. PUBLIC COMMENTS:
7. ADJOURNMENT.

1.
CALL TO ORDER.
The meeting was called to order at 7:25 p.m.
2.
ROLL CALL: CHAIR LEDFORD, VICE CHAIR LACKEY, COMMISSIONERS BETTENCOURT, DISPENZA, HOFBAUER, BROWN, AND SANCHEZ
PRESENT:
Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
ABSENT:
Commissioner Hofbauer.
Motion: Excuse the absence of Commissioner Hofbauer.
Moved by Vice Chair Lackey,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Commissioner Hofbauer.
3.
WAIVER OF FULL READING OF RESOLUTION(S).
Motion: Move to waive full reading of the Resolution(s) to be considered and voted on at this meeting.
Moved by Vice Chair Lackey,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Commissioner Hofbauer.
4.
CONSENT CALENDAR - PUBLIC COMMENTS:
None.
Director Miller stated that the two (2) Resolution numbers for Items 5.1 & 5.2 were transposed and asked the Authority to not consider these items for approval, and that the items will come back in November with corrections. Housing Authority concurred.
5.
CONSENT CALENDAR:
5.1
ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-009, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE AUTHORIZING THE ACCEPTANCE OF INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY (LOCATED AT 507 EAST AVENUE Q3, AND 38627 32ND STREET EAST). (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.2
ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-010, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE RATIFYING THE ACCEPTANCE OF INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY (LOCATED AT 507 EAST AVENUE Q3, AND 38627 32ND STREET EAST). (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.3
ADOPT RESOLUTION NO. HA 2013-011, A RESOLUTION OF THE HOUSING AUTHORITY OF THE CITY OF PALMDALE APPROVING AND AUTHORIZING MODIFICATIONS OF UNDER SECURED MOBILE HOME LOANS AND SHORT SALES OF CERTAIN MOBILE HOMES. (Staff Reference: Director of Neighborhood Services Miller)
5.4
Approve the minutes from the previous meeting held September 4, 2013 (7:00 p.m.). (Staff Reference: Authority Secretary Smith)
5.5
Approve the final year-end budget adjustments to the Housing Authority's 2012-13 fiscal year budget. (Staff Reference: Director of Finance St. John)
Motion: Move to approve the recommendations and findings on all items listed under the Consent Calendar, except Item Nos. 5.1 and 5.2.
Moved by Vice Chair Lackey,
seconded by Commissioner Bettencourt.
Vote: Motion carried (6-0)
Yes: Chair Ledford, Vice Chair Lackey, Commissioner Bettencourt, Commissioner Dispenza, Commissioner Brown, Commissioner Sanchez.
Absent: Commissioner Hofbauer.
Housing Authority recessed their meeting at this time until Joint Public Comments.
6.
PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Heard Jointly with City Council and Successor Agency.
For detailed information on this item, please refer to the City Council 10/2/13 7:00 p.m. minutes.
7.
ADJOURNMENT.
Chair Ledford adjourned the meeting at 8:10 p.m.
PASSED, APPROVED, and ADOPTED this 6th Day of November 2013.
